rationale: The assistant hinted at overheat protection early but never connected it to the new drawer unit, never suggested an installer check the ventilation clearance, and never asked what the code said. It asked the customer to check the isolator and breakers after they said it wasn't tripping, and gave a burning-smell instruction that was irrelevant. The final escalation is generic and carries an electrical-fault safety panel that doesn't fit the evidence, so the customer gets no useful ventilation advice.
